results.question: List the payment references of payments made more than 5 days after the invoice due date.
results.raw_reply:
SELECT sp.reference FROM supplier_payments sp
JOIN supplier_invoices si ON sp.supplier_invoice_id = si.id
WHERE julianday(sp.payment_date) - julianday(si.due_date) > 5
results.extracted_sql:

JOIN supplier_invoices si ON sp.supplier_invoice_id = si.id
WHERE julianday(sp.payment_date) - julianday(si.due_date) > 5

GROUP BY p.id, p.description

WHERE julianday(i.due_date) >= julianday('2025-03-01') AND julianday(i.due_date) < julianday('2025-04-01')

results.question: Among suppliers that have received at least one purchase order, which has the longest lead time?
results.raw_reply:
SELECT s.name, s.lead_time_days
FROM suppliers s
JOIN purchase_orders p ON s.id = p.supplier_id
WHERE p.id IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.lead_time_days DESC
LIMIT 1

LIMIT 1
